about: SDK 20's sprays in the real game: two FLAM-40 copies with damage of their own (HfWeapon.spray_damage), a scaled copy of the FLAM-40's and the TX-41 Sterilizer's gas, each in a SprayWeapon record of its own while the FLAM-40 keeps its own; the hot copy's stratagem in the loadout on the ship, called in, and its hellpod bringing the copy (tests/in-game/README.md). Spraying enemies with it is by hand.

checks.name: the damage, both copies and the stratagem are added
the hot copy has its own spray record with its own damage
the gas copy has its own spray record with the Sterilizer's damage
the FLAM-40 keeps its own damage
the loader writes each copy's spray damage
checks.regex: its spray deals damage \d+ \(its base's deals 14\)

checks.name: the hot copy's stratagem is in the loadout on the ship
